headline: Healthy execution and inflows amid input pressure

highlights: Siemens (SIEM) reported a mixed quarter, with revenue growing 17.0% YoY to INR 57.3bn, while EBITDA margin contracted 193bps YoY to 10.9%, impacted by adverse forex movements and elevated commodity prices.
Smart Infrastructure (SI) delivered robust revenue growth of 20.4% YoY, supported by demand across power T&D capex, grid modernisation, data centre investments and commercial infrastructure.
Mobility reported healthy revenue growth of 13.8% YoY, supported by demand across railway electrification and modernisation, high-speed mobility and rail automation.

However, margins across all three segments remained under pressure from elevated material costs, commodity volatility and adverse forex movements, with Mobility (-364bps YoY) and Digital Industries (-200bps YoY) witnessing sharper contractions.
